patch.structural_finding: sum of projected_off_possessions over a team-game's Tier A candidates equals EXACTLY 5x projected_team_off_possessions (max abs dev 1.1e-13). T_team does not depend on the candidate list, so candidate-set and allocation errors cannot change forecast VOLUME, only the weighted mean rate. Only the possession total and the rate can move the team forecast.
